scripts.docker:up: nub exec varlock run --filter=#docker --inject vars -- node scripts/docker.mjs up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 120
scripts.docker:down: nub exec varlock run --filter=#docker --inject vars -- node scripts/docker.mjs down
scripts.docker:build: nub exec varlock run --filter=#docker --inject vars -- node scripts/docker.mjs build
scripts.docker:ps: nub exec varlock run --filter=#docker --inject vars -- node scripts/docker.mjs ps
scripts.docker:logs: nub exec varlock run --filter=#docker --inject vars -- node scripts/docker.mjs logs --tail=100
scripts.test: nub --cwd packages/db run test && nub --node --test scripts/docker.test.mjs scripts/env.test.mjs
scripts.docker:bot:up: nub exec varlock run --filter=#docker,#bot,#jobs --inject vars -- node scripts/docker.mjs --profile bot up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 180
